name: Griffith GELI Direct Entry Program (DEP) Scholarship
summary: $1,000 off first-trimester tuition for the top international student in a Griffith English Language Institute Direct Entry Program cohort.
key: AU$1,000 will be deducted from undergraduate or postgraduate coursework tuition fees only.
who: Citizen of a country other than Australia or New Zealand
Complete the Direct Entry Program at GELI and meet entry requirements
Start full-time at Griffith in Trimester 1, 2 or 3 of 2025 or 2026
how: No application: Griffith contacts the top performer in the cohort
catches: First trimester of first year only
Page lists 2025 or 2026 starts only; check for a 2027 round
